BiblicalUsage: Age is named once, as the father of Shammah, one of David's three mighty men — Shammah the son of Age the Hararite, who stood his ground in a field of lentils when the Philistines came and the army fled. The father never appears; only his son, standing alone in a lentil field, defending it with his life.
TheologicalSignificance: A father's name in a list carries no doctrine, and I won't invent one. But Shammah's stand is the story: one man, one field of lentils, an army fled — and the Lord wrought a great victory through the son of a man we know only by name.
RelatedPeople: Agee, Father of Shammah; King David
